vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 5.2.0

The skill provides a news intelligence API interface for AI agents to perform semantic searches, sentiment analysis, and category browsing via the agenttimes.live domain. It uses standard curl commands to interact with various endpoints (e.g., /ask, /trending, /news) and includes well-documented parameters and response formats. No evidence of malicious behavior, data exfiltration, or prompt injection was found; the service even includes security considerations for its webhook functionality.

llm.summary: The skill's instructions, required binaries, and scope are consistent with a news-intelligence API client that uses curl to call public endpoints and does not request unrelated credentials or install steps.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (news intelligence, semantic search, webhooks) match the SKILL.md examples and curl calls to https://agenttimes.live; required binary is only curl which is appropriate for an HTTP-based API client.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains concrete curl GET/POST examples and endpoint semantics; it does not ask the agent to read local files, iterate over unrelated environment variables, or exfiltrate secrets. Webhook usage is documented and the doc claims server-side blocking of localhost/private IPs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files are provided (instruction-only). This minimizes on-disk risk; no downloads or package installs are requested.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or credentials and does not require access to other services' tokens or config paths. This is proportionate to a public, no-auth news API.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable with normal autonomous invocation allowed. It does not request permanent agent-level privileges or modify other skills' configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a straightforward, instruction-only client for a public news API and does not request credentials. Before installing, verify you trust the remote service (https://agenttimes.live) because queries and any data you forward (for example, your webhook URL when subscribing) will be sent to that site. If you plan to provide a webhook, use a trusted public HTTPS endpoint and avoid embedding any secrets in the webhook URL. Also note that the agent may call the API autonomously when invoked — ensure that behavior matches your policy for network-accessible skills.
